recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; do not reintroduce deprecation text or duplicate the existing subscriptionTopic element semantics unless the work group makes a new decision.
issue_request: FHIR-21232 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked to clarify EventDefinition/TriggerDefinition reuse boundaries by deprecating EventDefinition in favor of SubscriptionTopic and allowing TriggerDefinition to refer to a SubscriptionTopic that completely defines the event.
initial_application: The Jira-linked PR HL7/fhir#2288, merged as 13fb5889ecbc08b05d25cd2023c933b94581df24, applied the TriggerDefinition part structurally by adding TriggerDefinition.subscriptionTopic as canonical(SubscriptionTopic) with no-other-trigger-information semantics rather than by adding the proposed sentence verbatim to TriggerDefinition.name.
additional_context: FHIR-41372 later applied the EventDefinition deprecation in favor of SubscriptionTopic for R6, but FHIR-53316 subsequently superseded that direction by undeprecating EventDefinition and adding current relationship guidance. FHIR-53414 later refined TriggerDefinition subscription-topic guidance and invariants and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already has subscription-topic trigger support and the current EventDefinition page correctly follows the later FHIR-53316 undeprecation and relationship text.
